title.en: How Soy Sauce Gets Its Flavor

desc.zh: 黄豆、小麦、盐和水，单独都不鲜、不香、不黑，放在一起半年却成了酱油；也有的酱油几天就做出来。六个可以拖动的模型：曲床发热、小麦带来的糖、盐水里乳酸菌和酵母的接力、颜色和温度、瓶子上的氨基酸态氮、一勺里的钠。
desc.en: Soybeans, wheat, salt and water are each bland, pale and odourless, yet half a year together turns them into soy sauce; some soy sauce is made in days. Six models you can push: a heating koji bed, the sugar wheat brings, the hand-over from lactic bacteria to yeast in brine, colour and temperature, the amino-nitrogen number on the label, and the sodium in a spoonful.

title.zh: 酱油的三段：制曲、酱醪、加热
title.en: Soy sauce in three stages: koji, moromi, heating

desc.zh: 两三天养曲霉，几个月让盐水里的乳酸菌和酵母接力，最后几十分钟加热；时间轴上的点由后面的模型算出。
desc.en: Two to three days of mould, months of a bacteria-to-yeast relay in brine, then minutes of heating; the timeline points come from the later models.

en: how long does soy sauce ferment

title.en: Koji: growing a batch of enzymes

desc.zh: 曲霉长在蒸黄豆和炒小麦上，两三天造出蛋白酶和淀粉酶；生长放热，曲床太厚不翻就超过 40 °C。逻辑斯谛生长加热量平衡的模型。
desc.en: Koji mould grows on steamed soybeans and roasted wheat and makes proteases and amylases in two to three days; growth releases heat and a thick unturned bed passes 40 °C. Logistic growth with a heat balance.

desc.zh: 黄豆给蛋白质，小麦给淀粉和糖；按比例算出的糖决定后面的酵母吃不吃得饱。溜酱油、浓口、中式 80:20 与 70:30 的比较。
desc.en: Soybeans bring protein, wheat brings starch and sugar; the sugar the ratio provides decides whether the yeast later has enough to eat. Tamari, koikuchi and Chinese 80:20 and 70:30 compared.

title.zh: 盐水里的接力：乳酸菌和酵母
title.en: The relay in brine: lactic bacteria then yeast

desc.zh: 嗜盐四联球菌先产酸把 pH 拉到 5 以下，鲁氏接合酵母才能在浓盐里接棒产酒精和香气；盐超过约 20.6% 或温度太低，接力就失败。
desc.en: Tetragenococcus halophilus acidifies the mash below pH 5 so that Zygosaccharomyces rouxii can take over in strong brine and make ethanol and aroma; above about 20.6% salt or in the cold the relay fails.

desc.zh: 氨基酸和糖的美拉德反应生成类黑精；阿伦尼乌斯方程换算加热、室温和冰箱的差别，结论取决于在酱油上还没测准的活化能。开瓶后变深还和氧化有关。
desc.en: The Maillard reaction between amino acids and sugars makes melanoidins; the Arrhenius equation compares heating, room temperature and the fridge, and the answer hinges on an activation energy not yet measured for soy sauce. Oxidation also darkens an opened bottle.

zh: 酱油开封后为什么变黑

title.en: Where soy sauce aroma comes from

desc.zh: 酵母带来酒精、HEMF 和甲硫醇，念珠菌把小麦的酚类变成 4-乙基愈创木酚，加热生成呋喃酮。
desc.en: Yeast brings ethanol, HEMF and methionol, Candida turns wheat phenolics into 4-ethylguaiacol, and heating forms furanones.

title.zh: 氨基酸态氮：瓶子上的数字
title.en: Amino-acid nitrogen: the number on the bottle

desc.zh: 甲醛滴定数的是游离氨基，加进去的谷氨酸钠和铵盐也会被数进去；GB/T 18186 的特级到三级，2025 版的铵盐上限 28%，以及日本 JAS 按总氮分级。
desc.en: Formol titration counts free amino groups, so added sodium glutamate and ammonium count too; the GB/T 18186 grades, the 28% ammonium cap in the 2025 edition, and Japan's JAS grades by total nitrogen.

title.zh: 酿半年和做几天：酿造酱油、低盐固态和酸水解
title.en: Six months or a few days: brewed, low-salt solid-state and acid-hydrolysed

desc.zh: 高盐稀态走完整个接力；低盐固态更快；酸水解几天切完蛋白质、会生成 3-MCPD，在中国现行规定下不能叫酱油（GB 2717-2018、GB/T 18186-2025、GB 2762-2025）。
desc.en: High-salt liquid brewing runs the whole relay; low-salt solid-state is faster; acid hydrolysis breaks protein in days and forms 3-MCPD, and under current Chinese rules may not be called soy sauce.

title.en: Why soy sauce is so salty

desc.zh: 浓盐水是酿造条件的一部分；日本几种酱油每 100 克含钠约 5.1–6.3 克，淡口比浓口更咸。只讲含量和机制。
desc.en: Strong brine is part of the brewing; about 5.1–6.3 g sodium per 100 g in Japanese styles, and usukuchi is saltier than koikuchi. Content and mechanism only.
